normalization: mean centering and population SD scaling
methods: cloned_reference: retained former default allocating hook, preserving dense overrides
operator: public LazyMatrix::matvec using the implemented conditional borrow
dense_controls: Both methods preserve the specialized backend normalization hook.
scaled_controls: Both methods preserve the existing allocating normalized hook when scales are present.
timing_units: nanoseconds per product or input clone, including returned-vector destruction
timing_estimator: Criterion mean with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals
compute_coordination: Both complete runs share one exclusive compute bench reservation. The retained reference and public operator use the same executable and fixture.
allocation_method: One warmed untimed call per case and run; count successful allocation and reallocation calls and cumulative requested bytes, excluding setup and deallocation.
scope: Production conditional borrow in the default allocating forward hook; finite owned f64 vectors, six sparse backend/layout combinations, and three dense controls. Public signatures and trait bounds are unchanged.
